description.value: A private oceanfront resort on the old Island Highway near Qualicum Beach, open roughly July 1 to September 1, offering coastal views over the Strait of Georgia; amenity details are thin on the website so arrive with expectations calibrated.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at resortbc.com confirms this is Qualicum Bay Resort at 5970 Island Hwy W., Qualicum Beach BC V9K 2N1, and supplies a phone number (1-250-757-2003) absent from OSM. The site is extremely sparse — primarily marketing copy about 'oceanfront tranquility' and 'serene camping options' — so no specific amenities can be confirmed beyond online booking implied by prominent 'Book Your Stay' and 'Book Now' calls to action. OSM tags add only the caravan_site category and address, which the website corroborates.
concerns: Website is extremely minimal with almost no facility or amenity detail; most optional amenities are unverifiable.
Phone number 1-250-757-2003 is confirmed on the website but was absent from the OSM record.
OSM address uses 'West Island Highway' while the website uses 'Island Hwy W.' — same road, minor formatting discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate oceanfront camping resort on Vancouver Island's Island Highway corridor — a natural stop for touring cyclists — with a live website, confirmed address, and bookable stays. Amenity detail is sparse but the listing has value as a location marker.
